build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
inputs: The 25 width-256 original GGML source buffers from ggml-packed-add-words.tsv, each containing two rows. The F32 addend is ((13*i+7) mod 29 - 14)/32.
oracle: Execute original GGML CPU ggml_add_cast with F32 output once per source. Pass each summed two-row buffer to ggml_quantize_chunk for each of the seven destinations. Supply a width-256 vector of ones exactly when ggml_quantize_requires_imatrix returns true. Each destination lacks a CPU from_float row callback.
